steps.title: Prepare 2 % Evans blue (IP)
steps.instruction: Make the 2 % (w/v) Evans blue solution, vortex to homogenize, transfer to a 20 mL syringe, filter through a 0.22 µm syringe filter and keep at room temperature.

steps.title: Weigh mice for IP injection
steps.instruction: Place each mouse on a balance and record its weight.

steps.title: Inject Evans blue intraperitoneally
steps.instruction: Load a 27G × 13 mm insulin syringe with 2 % Evans blue at 4 mL per kg mouse body weight, remove all bubbles, hold the mouse by tail and neck, expose the abdomen, clean the injection site with 70 % ethanol, insert the needle at a 45° angle (optional aspirate), and slowly deliver the dye.

steps.title: Allow dye absorption (IP)
steps.instruction: Return the mouse to its cage and let the dye circulate for 3 h; footpads, nose and ears should turn slightly blue.

steps.title: Prepare 0.5 % Evans blue (IV)
steps.instruction: Make the 0.5 % (w/v) Evans blue solution, vortex, transfer to a 20 mL syringe, filter through a 0.22 µm syringe filter and keep at room temperature.

steps.title: Weigh mice for IV injection
steps.instruction: Place each mouse on a balance and record its weight.

steps.title: Dilate tail veins
steps.instruction: Keep the mouse under an infrared lamp for 5–10 min (or incubate the tail in 37 °C water) to dilate the lateral tail veins.

steps.title: Inject Evans blue intravenously
steps.instruction: Load a 27G × 13 mm syringe with 100 µL of 0.5 % Evans blue per mouse, remove bubbles, place the mouse in a restrainer, clean the tail with 70 % ethanol, insert the needle flat into the lateral vein, and slowly administer the dye.

steps.title: Allow dye circulation (IV)
steps.instruction: Return the mouse to its cage and let the dye circulate for 30–60 min; after ~30 min the footpads, nose and ears should turn blue.

steps.title: Prepare anesthesia solution
steps.instruction: Mix ketamine (100 mg/kg) and xylazine (13 mg/kg) in saline to a total volume of 1.5 mL per mouse (12.5 µL per g body weight) as described in the recipes.

steps.title: Anesthetize mouse
steps.instruction: Administer the anesthesia intraperitoneally, wait 10 min, and confirm loss of pain reflex by pinching the paws with forceps.

steps.title: Shave back skin
steps.instruction: Turn the mouse and shave the dorsal skin with a veterinary clipper; wait 1 h after shaving (or shave the day before) to avoid irritation.

steps.title: Prepare sterile histamine solution
steps.instruction: Make a histamine solution of 20 ng/µL (1 000 ng in 50 µL PBS) as described in the recipes.

steps.title: Inject histamine intradermally
steps.instruction: Load a 27G × 13 mm insulin syringe with 50 µL histamine solution, stretch the skin with index finger and thumb, insert ~5 mm of needle at a 45° angle, and slowly deliver the solution; a skin bubble must form to confirm intradermal injection.

substeps.instruction: Repeat up to six injections per mouse, spacing sites 1–2 cm apart, always using 50 µL per site.

steps.title: Incubate post‑injection
steps.instruction: Return the mouse to its cage and wait 30 min.

steps.title: Euthanize mouse
steps.instruction: Euthanize the anesthetized mouse by cervical dislocation or by a triple overdose of the anesthesia used earlier.

steps.title: Excise dorsal skin
steps.instruction: Make a transversal incision in the lower skin with surgical scissors, separate skin from muscle with Kelly forceps, and cut the entire back skin leaving ~0.5 cm margins around injection sites.

steps.title: Collect injection‑site circles
steps.instruction: Cut ~1 cm diameter circles centered on the blue leakage around each injection site.

steps.title: Extract Evans blue from skin
steps.instruction: Place each skin circle in 1 mL dimethylformamide inside a 2 mL microtube, rotate at 40 rpm at room temperature for 24 h.

steps.title: Measure dye absorbance
steps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL of dimethylformamide blank and 100 µL of each sample supernatant to cuvettes or a microplate and read absorbance at 620 nm.

steps.title: Dry and weigh skin samples
steps.instruction: Remove skin circles from the tubes, dry them on the workbench at room temperature for 2 days, then weigh each dried sample on an analytical balance.
